name: Reelbase
description: Get music video metadata and artwork from a Reelbase instance. Requires a Reelbase API key, which is free to create on any Reelbase site.
overview: Get music video metadata and artwork from Reelbase

versions.changelog: Honour the Retry-After the API now returns on a 429: wait when it is brief, stop until then when it is not, and remember the wait across restarts.
